about_short_description.short_description: Rutter is specialized in radar signal processing technologies for the marine safety, security and environmental monitoring sectors.

product.name: sigma S6 Current Monitor™
product.description: Radar-based system providing high-resolution ocean surface current data and shallow water bathymetry to support marine operations and environmental monitoring.

product.name: sigma S6 Ice Navigator™
product.description: Radar-based system that detects and tracks ice features to aid navigation and ice management in polar and ice-threatened waters.

product.name: sigma S6 Oil Spill Detection
product.description: Radar-based system for early detection, outlining, and monitoring of oil spills to support response and environmental protection.

product.name: sigma S6 Small Target Surveillance
product.description: Radar enhancement system that detects and tracks small vessels and objects for security, safety, and search and rescue operations.

product.name: sigma S6 WaMoS® II
product.description: Radar-based system providing real-time wave and surface current measurements to support marine operations and environmental monitoring.

product.name: sigma S6 WaveSignal™
product.description: Radar-based wave prediction system that forecasts wave activity to aid safe marine operations and personnel transfers.
